f1_data.collection_method: HTTP GET of season endpoints (schedule, results, qualifying, sprint, final standings), paginated, cached as JSON
f1_data.licence: Jolpica/Ergast data - free for non-commercial use; see https://github.com/jolpica/jolpica-f1 for current terms

weather.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis)
weather.collection_method: One request per race using circuit lat/lon, hourly temperature_2m/precipitation/rain around the race start (UTC)
weather.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); ERA5 data from Copernicus Climate Change Service
